// RED probe — rule 2 (tainted alias interpolated into bilingual customer copy).
// This is lib/services/timeline/build.ts's exact pre-fix shape: the file never
// spells a sentinel — it reads the FIELD, renames it, and interpolates it two
// object keys later. The literal scan is green on this file; the render
// boundary must not be.
export function probe(policy: { insurerName: string | null }, branch: { en: string; el: string }) {
    const insurer = policy.insurerName?.trim()
    return {
        title: {
            en: `${branch.en} policy added${insurer ? ` — ${insurer}` : ""}`,
            el: `Προστέθηκε ασφαλιστήριο ${branch.el}${insurer ? ` — ${insurer}` : ""}`,
        },
    }
}
